001package bank.persistence;
002
003import bank.model.Account;
004import bank.model.Bank;
005import bank.model.CheckingAccount;
006import bank.model.LoanAccount;
007import bank.model.SavingsAccount;
008
009import com.google.gson.Gson;
010import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
011import com.google.gson.JsonDeserializationContext;
012import com.google.gson.JsonDeserializer;
013import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
014import com.google.gson.JsonIOException;
015import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
016import com.google.gson.JsonParseException;
017import com.google.gson.JsonSyntaxException;
018import com.google.gson.TypeAdapter;
019import com.google.gson.stream.JsonReader;
020import com.google.gson.stream.JsonToken;
021import com.google.gson.stream.JsonWriter;
022
023import java.lang.reflect.Type;
024
025import java.io.IOException;
026import java.io.Reader;
027import java.io.Writer;
028import java.math.BigDecimal;
029import java.nio.file.Files;
030import java.nio.file.Path;
031import java.nio.file.Paths;
032import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
033import java.time.LocalDateTime;
034import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
035
036/**
037 * ============================================================================
038 *  JsonStore.java
039 *  Owner: John (smartdude879@gmail.com)
040 * ============================================================================
041 *
042 *  ROLE:
043 *      The ONLY class allowed to touch bank.json directly. Reads and writes
044 *      the entire Bank object via Gson.
045 *
046 *  HANDLES:
047 *      - First run (file doesn't exist)  → returns empty Bank
048 *      - Corrupted JSON                  → backs up the bad file, returns empty Bank
049 *      - BigDecimal precision            → custom TypeAdapter
050 *      - LocalDateTime                   → ISO-8601 string adapter
051 *      - Account polymorphism            → manual "type" field switch
052 *      - Atomic writes                   → temp file + atomic rename
053 * ============================================================================
054 */
055public class JsonStore {
056
057    // ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
058    private static final String DATA_DIR  = "data";
059    private static final String DATA_FILE = DATA_DIR + "/bank.json";
060    private static final String BACKUP_SUFFIX = ".bak";
061
062    private final Gson gson;
063
064    public JsonStore() {
065        this.gson = buildGson();
066    }
067
068    // ── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
069
070    /**
071     * Saves the entire Bank to disk.
072     * Writes to a temp file first then atomically replaces the real file
073     * so a crash mid-write never corrupts the existing data.
074     *
075     * @param bank the bank state to persist
076     * @throws IOException if the file cannot be written
077     */
078    public void save(Bank bank) throws IOException {
079        Files.createDirectories(Paths.get(DATA_DIR));
080
081        Path tempPath = Paths.get(DATA_FILE + ".tmp");
082        try (Writer writer = Files.newBufferedWriter(tempPath)) {
083            gson.toJson(bank, writer);
084        }
085
086        try {
087            Files.move(tempPath, Paths.get(DATA_FILE),
088                    StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING,
089                    StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
090        } catch (IOException atomicFailed) {
091            // Some Windows filesystems don't support ATOMIC_MOVE — fall back
092            Files.move(tempPath, Paths.get(DATA_FILE),
093                    StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
094        }
095    }
096
097    /**
098     * Loads the Bank from disk.
099     * Returns an empty Bank if the file doesn't exist.
100     * Backs up corrupted JSON and returns an empty Bank.
101     *
102     * @return the loaded bank, or a fresh empty Bank
103     */
104    public Bank load() {
105        Path filePath = Paths.get(DATA_FILE);
106
107        if (!Files.exists(filePath)) {
108            System.out.println("[JsonStore] No bank.json found — starting with an empty bank.");
109            return new Bank();
110        }
111
112        try (Reader reader = Files.newBufferedReader(filePath)) {
113            Bank bank = gson.fromJson(reader, Bank.class);
114            if (bank == null) {
115                System.out.println("[JsonStore] bank.json was empty — starting fresh.");
116                return new Bank();
117            }
118            System.out.println("[JsonStore] Loaded bank.json successfully.");
119            return bank;
120
121        } catch (JsonSyntaxException | JsonIOException e) {
122            backupCorruptedFile(filePath);
123            System.err.println("[JsonStore] WARNING: bank.json is corrupted. Backup created. Starting fresh.");
124            return new Bank();
125
126        } catch (IOException e) {
127            System.err.println("[JsonStore] Could not read bank.json: " + e.getMessage());
128            return new Bank();
129        }
130    }
131
132    // ── Internal helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
133
134    private void backupCorruptedFile(Path original) {
135        String timestamp = LocalDateTime.now()
136                .format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"));
137        Path backup = Paths.get(DATA_FILE + "." + timestamp + BACKUP_SUFFIX);
138        try {
139            Files.copy(original, backup, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
140            System.err.println("[JsonStore] Backup saved to: " + backup);
141        } catch (IOException ex) {
142            System.err.println("[JsonStore] Could not create backup: " + ex.getMessage());
143        }
144    }
145
146    private Gson buildGson() {
147        return new GsonBuilder()
148                .setPrettyPrinting()
149                .registerTypeAdapter(BigDecimal.class, bigDecimalAdapter())
150                .registerTypeAdapter(LocalDateTime.class, localDateTimeAdapter())
151                .registerTypeAdapter(Account.class, accountDeserializer())
152                .create();
153    }
154
155    // ── Custom TypeAdapters ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
156
157    /** Preserves exact decimal strings (e.g. "500.00") so no floating-point drift. */
158    private TypeAdapter<BigDecimal> bigDecimalAdapter() {
159        return new TypeAdapter<BigDecimal>() {
160            @Override
161            public void write(JsonWriter out, BigDecimal value) throws IOException {
162                if (value == null) { out.nullValue(); return; }
163                out.value(value.toPlainString());
164            }
165            @Override
166            public BigDecimal read(JsonReader in) throws IOException {
167                if (in.peek() == JsonToken.NULL) { in.nextNull(); return null; }
168                return new BigDecimal(in.nextString());
169            }
170        };
171    }
172
173    /** Stores LocalDateTime as an ISO-8601 string. */
174    private TypeAdapter<LocalDateTime> localDateTimeAdapter() {
175        return new TypeAdapter<LocalDateTime>() {
176            @Override
177            public void write(JsonWriter out, LocalDateTime value) throws IOException {
178                if (value == null) { out.nullValue(); return; }
179                out.value(value.toString());
180            }
181            @Override
182            public LocalDateTime read(JsonReader in) throws IOException {
183                if (in.peek() == JsonToken.NULL) { in.nextNull(); return null; }
184                return LocalDateTime.parse(in.nextString());
185            }
186        };
187    }
188
189    /**
190     * Handles Account polymorphism. Gson cannot guess which subclass of
191     * Account to build, so we read the "type" field by hand and call back
192     * into Gson with the right concrete class.
193     */
194    private JsonDeserializer<Account> accountDeserializer() {
195        return new JsonDeserializer<Account>() {
196            @Override
197            public Account deserialize(JsonElement json, Type typeOfT,
198                                       JsonDeserializationContext context) {
199                JsonObject obj = json.getAsJsonObject();
200                String type = obj.has("type") ? obj.get("type").getAsString() : "";
201
202                switch (type.toUpperCase()) {
203                    case "CHECKING":
204                        return context.deserialize(obj, CheckingAccount.class);
205                    case "SAVINGS":
206                        return context.deserialize(obj, SavingsAccount.class);
207                    case "LOAN":
208                        return context.deserialize(obj, LoanAccount.class);
209                    default:
210                        throw new JsonParseException("Unknown account type: " + type);
211                }
212            }
213        };
214    }
215}
